Interface Gpio

All Known Implementing Classes:
NativeGpio
public interface Gpio
The board's GPIO pins. A board facade such as ArduinoUno.getGpio() or Esp32Cam.getGpio() exposes the board's own pins, which the compiler lowers to the Arduino core calls; a unit test passes mock(Gpio.class) instead. Pin numbers and modes come from the static getters (getD13(), getOutput()): portable pin identifiers, D0-D13 as 0-13 and A0-A5 as 14-19. The runtime translates these identifiers to the linked board's pins and modes; they are not raw MCU GPIO numbers. On the Nano ESP32, for example, D13 reaches GPIO48 and A4 reaches GPIO11. Get the board's pins once, at startup, and pass them to the classes that need them.
